notes: Agassiz's 'Ganoid fishes' is an obsolete paraphyletic group (gars, bowfin, sturgeons, paddlefishes and fossil relatives); it has no GBIF/NCBI node, so only the Wikidata item for the historical group is given.
resolution_notes: GBIF backbone has no node for this taxon (it only carries kingdom to species ranks, or treats the name as a synonym/doubtful).
